title: Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of IONIS-MAPTRx in Patients With Mild Alzheimer's Disease
one_line: This ClinicalTrials.gov record details the trial design, safety, and pharmacokinetic outcomes of the tau-targeting antisense oligonucleotide IONIS-MAPTRx in a Phase 1 study for mild Alzheimer's disease.
summary: This document is a ClinicalTrials.gov registry record (NCT03186989) for a Phase 1 interventional study of IONIS-MAPTRx (ISIS 814907), an intrathecally administered antisense oligonucleotide targeting tau. The trial enrolled 46 patients with mild Alzheimer's disease and consisted of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multiple ascending dose phase followed by an open-label extension. The primary endpoints focused on the frequency and severity of treatment-emergent adverse events over 37 to 64 weeks. Secondary endpoints measured pharmacokinetic properties such as CSF trough concentrations, Cmax, Tmax, terminal elimination half-life, and AUC across doses ranging from 10 mg to 115 mg. The document provides raw incidence rates for adverse events, highlighting procedural complications like post-lumbar puncture syndrome, as well as pharmacokinetic data distributions, without offering a peer-reviewed narrative or statistical conclusions.

key_claims.claim: IONIS-MAPTRx exhibits a measurable pharmacokinetic profile in both plasma and CSF across doses from 10 mg to 115 mg.
key_claims.evidence: Raw data for Cmax, Tmax, AUC, and CSF trough concentrations are listed across the multiple ascending dose and open-label extension cohorts.

key_claims.claim: Procedural and administration-related adverse events occurred in the study population.
key_claims.evidence: Adverse event tables show incidences of post lumbar puncture syndrome, procedural pain, and puncture site reactions across both active and placebo cohorts.

methods.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multiple ascending dose study, followed by an open-label extension
methods.population: Males or females aged 50-74 years diagnosed with mild Alzheimer's disease
methods.duration: Up to Week 37 in Part 1 and Week 64 in Part 2

funding_and_conflicts: Lead sponsor: Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. No conflicts stated.
limitations: Document is a raw clinical trial registry record, lacking statistical analyses or peer-reviewed narrative conclusions.
Small sample sizes per cohort (4 to 13 participants) limit generalizability.
red_flags: Results are presented as detached, flattened data points without explicit context or significance testing.

issues: ClinicalTrials.gov tabular data for secondary outcomes (like CSF Trough Concentration and Cmax) are flattened into a list of bullet points ('- value: ...'), losing the visual mapping to their specific dosage cohorts.

search_verification: Searched web knowledge to confirm NCT03186989 corresponds to the MAPTRx trial (BIIB080) published in Nature Medicine in 2023 (Mummery et al.), though the provided text is strictly the registry data.
